methodologyNote: Measured via search host referrals in tracked traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts (mobile) in Japan at 84.24% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Yahoo! search.yahoo.co.jp ranked second at 9.08%, followed by Google google.com.hk at 1.62%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts (mobile) in Japan?
faqs.answer: Google google.com leads at 84.24% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-host-market-share/mobile/japan.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts (mobile) in Japan?
faqs.answer: Google google.com (84.24%), Yahoo! search.yahoo.co.jp (9.08%), Google google.com.hk (1.62%) in October 2026.
